releases.notes:
Ok so it's been a bit since i've made a release on this repository (and to curse forge) but I have great news, I'm back and so is this mod.

New features:

-           Class system, this dictates what armor you spawn with when entering lyoko
-           Minecraft 1.18.2 finally
-           Custom Death screen
-           new system for handling multiblock structures, mainly for performance
-           new Vehicle, the Skid Bladnir

Known Issues:

-         some Items don't work like they used to
-         the inventory saving doesn't consistently work so you may lose your items when entering lyoko YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED
-         the class gui isn't scared properly causing some of the text to go off screen
-         there's a weird edgecase with the block pattern api that forge provides where when checking the world against a pattern it could crash because another pattern defined in the same file is incomplete, even if it has nothing to do with the current pattern being searched
-         some of the mobs don't have a renderer still, but the Blok, Hornet, Manta, Hoverboard, and Overboard have all of their renderers
-        the skid has some weird textures (ha ha obj uv mapping) and for some reason travels very slowly in the digital sea
-        the digital sea has no floor so if you're not careful you could fall out of the world
-        a bunch of textures are still missing
-        blocks that spawn in the world can no longer be mined with a pickaxe or anything until I can register their loot tables and block tags
-        if you run while shooting the laser arrow with ODD's gauntlet you can hit yourself on accident and it instantly kills you
-        balance issues
-        the Zweihander still is massive, and still has some frame rate issues

releases.notes:
Major additions:
-Added the Overbike, Overboard, and Hoverboard Vehicles

-Added the digital frontier dimension
-Added the towers

-Added crafting recipes to some stuff (or at least I started to anyways)
-Added the manta, and kankrelat (animations still a work in progresS)

-Added a test for the portal (meant to appear as a new voxel shape inside of the scanner)
-Properly added in cables though they're still a work in progress (Thanks to Elsopéen on the github)

-New Custom skybox in Sector 5

-Added some optional and required dependencies

Minor additions:
-Behind the scenes additions as a base for the multiblocks

-a few bug fixes mainly regarding some logic here and there and the music in the dimensions

-changed a few block properties

Known Bugs:
-The message for Xana attacking shows up everytime the world is loaded, and that system isn't even done yet so it's a bug for now

-trying to use the cable for more that 1 machine doesn't work (still a work in progress)

-Entities can spawn above the actual ground of the dimension causing them to fall to their deaths, and they can spawn over the digital ocean

-The overbike will fall through the ground because there's no collision on it
-The Overboard and Hoverboard don't move super smoothly, and can't stop completely unless dismounted from, and plus they don't move with the player like they're meant to (they even sometimes just rotate when the player rotates whether they're being ridden or not)

-Music loop issues, Ticks don't seem to work in code like they do in-game

releases.notes:
This is going to be a while, but in the meantime, here's some more features that looks like it's pretty damn close to a beta release
Major changes:
-Sector 5 Generates an actual sphere now with an inner sphere (now we just need to figure out how the hell to get random terrain to generate in between those)
-Liquid Helium flows but nothing else for some reason (Liquid helium also for some reason looks like regular water, but we'll get to that when the time comes)

-Added Animated MegaTank Entity
-Added Animated Hornet Entity

-French translation started (Thanks to Elsopéen on the github)
-Re-worked the fan model
-Re-worked the Blok model (the mob isn't textured or animated yet, but it's a better quality model)

-Aelita's Armor now comes with a usable forcefield emitter (I still need to figure out how to gait it so that people can't just bring what's meant for lyoko only into the overworld/nether/end)
-Added a bucket model for liquid helium (will add more for the other fluids)
-Added a crap load of models for a majority of the items
-it's not done but I've added what's meant to be cables for the super computer
-Added smelting recipes to some ores
-Attempted to make some ores generate (please respond if they don't generate)
Minor changes
-Some bug fixes
-Performance Optimizations
Minor/Major Incomplete changes (that are in the files but not used yet)
- Various machines for creating hyper realistic electronics
- Various Multiblocks
- Allowing each mob to spawn
- Making the hornet a ranged flying mob I.E. a combination between the bee and the blaze mob (for now it's basically just a phantom)
- Making each mob spawn in each dimension

- XANA attack system, basically randomly XANA will attack, there's not much planned for it right now they only thing it does currently is randomly say "xana is attacking"

- A character class that's meant to represent Jeremy Belpois as a full lyoko warrior instead of the computer master

- Will need to wait for the super computer to be done, but remote access to the super computer
Planned:
- The rest of the mobs, like the Tarantula, Creeper, Manta, Shark, Squid, and Fly (some of these are only present in codelyoko: Quest for infinity)
- Tower generation (we already have their interface)
- using GeckoLib to animate some blocks (only present in the pre-release snapshot builds, will not use until stable)
- A storyline that's meant to be sort of like a fan fiction-esk sort of thing that takes place years after the final season of the actual show
- the Important Multiblocks, such as the super computer multi-block
- The Skidbladnir (I don't know how to use OBJ models as entity models because I found a cool looking model for the skid online, credit to a user on VG-resource for that)
- Did I mention the hyper realistic resource refining stuff (eventually meant to work with the other techmods like ender IO (when they eventually update))
- a beta release at some point

releases.notes:
this changelog is going to be a very brief summary, because as per usual, too many features were added to make a comprehensive list

Major chages:
- Added scanner multiblock (it's a 1 x 1 x 4 structure, 1 base, 2 frames, 1 top)
- Added more ores to do with the creation of the various CPUS
- Added a boat load of items relating to the intricate creation of CPUs, all used in the eventual computer multiblock
- Added the mind helmet, currently if you wear it too long it just slowly hurts you, but it's meant to be for a research system (ha ha, i'm in danger)
- Added background music to more dimensions
- Added the core of lyoko (not generated yet, but you can use the commands to get it, because it took too much space in the inventory)
- Added a ton more models to everything
- Added Field emitter (still trying to work out the bugs with that)
- Yumi's fans actually work now
Minor changes:
- fixed a few bugs/logic errors with the laser arrow weapons
- Re-balanced more armor and weapons
- slight optimization
- added recipes to some stuff (oh god the amount of recipes I need to add)
- tweaks with some fluids (though I think there's a new fluid, I entirely forgot about the fluid situation from last update)
- Just incase y'all peek in the files, there is an interface to add 100% custom recipes, but I don't know how to use it
- added loot tables to blocks (why couldn't they have just kept all the block drops in code, it was way easier than lootables)
- Started to add some Item property overrides to some items
Known Bugs:
- Sometimes the armor dimension checking does give the correct items
- There's a rare chance that the Katana and the Zweihander might be unable to be held, it's due to the system to make them two handed weapons
- The fluids don't want to flow at all for some reason
- I don't know why, but certain things just flat out doesn't work, for whatever reason
Roadmap:
- Finish the freaking textures
- Computer multiblock
- Make sector 5 work
- I'm not adding anymore here, i've already done way too much feature creep to make programming not a pain

releases.notes:
at this point i've entirely given up on giving this a version
IMPORTANT NOTE: though I haven't added any animations to any entities yet, I added the GeckoLib as a required dependency so when I eventually add animations everyone already has the means to use the new version
Changes:
- Fixed some super minor bugs

- Reworked the Holoprojector Multi-Block (it still doesn't work quite right)
- Re-balanced the Zweihander
- Added some new models for more blocks for more Multi-blocks (when I figure out how to get them to work)
- Added a very terrible patchwork for playing music in the dimensions (the actual music volume in the settings need to be turned off in order for this to work)
- Added a Tinker's construct type book (I don't know how to make an actual book in minecraft so for now it just says it doesn't work yet)

- Added a spawn egg for the Blok mob
- Fixed the TowerInterface closing when the letter 'E' is typed
- In general cleaned up some code

- Added a particle effect to the tower walls
Kown Issues:
- for some reason, the code that tells the book to spawn when you join the world once breaks a bit on a server, it'll look like another player is holding the book item if they've died or re-join the server

- The entire HoloProjector Multi-block
- The Zweihander model still eats the frame rate
- Music may not loop properly if you stay in the dimensions for too long
- Not all dimensions have music
- the Uranium Waste doesn't flow, for some odd reason
- The Particle effect that I added, just in general
- Low framerate because i'm new to modding and terrible at programming

I know it's been a while since i've posted any releases on here because of my inability to remember that there's multiple websites I need to post to. but this is going to be a massive changelist now

Major updates:
-added tons more blocks (all to do with the uranium refinement system)
           currently they all have placeholder textures
-Added texture to the laser arrows, and changed how their physics works
-Changed attributes of the Zweihander
-Completely removed as much Instance abuse as I possibly could
-Started refactoring how the multi-blocks work
      previously each block used to make it was a tile entity, but this made it so that all of the blocks in the world of that type would be invisible
-Fixed the transparent block model
-Added a few new sectors since last release (for insance, sector 5 and it's blocks, but it's still a WIP)
-Regressed OBJ model progress with the holoprojector until I can get it sorted out
-Added music discs (currently it's only the main theme)
Minor updates:
-Fixed spelling mistakes in various places
-Fixed incorrect texture paths in various places
-Renamed the build file


IMPORTANT:
This version of the mod will be no longer supported after initial completion (or based on when the 1.15.2 version will be finished)
